decision.explanation: Document d2 directly states '2020 National Teacher of the Year Tabatha Rosproy Kansas...' which explicitly names Tabatha Rosproy as the 2020 National Teacher of the Year. Document d3 similarly states '2020 National Teacher of the Year Juliana Urtubey Kansas...' but this refers to a different person (Juliana Urtubey) and cannot be reconciled with the first claim. Since both documents cannot simultaneously be correct for the same title, only the claim from d2 is retained based on its direct assignment.
